name: Academia Arcana
blurb: Students at a school of magic: lessons, colleges, friendships, forbidden shelves, and the trouble magic makes.
description: A Powered by the Apocalypse magic-school game. Students learn spells, potions, and enchantments, take on classroom and campus challenges, navigate college politics, and research magic of their own. The GM invents the academy, its colleges, its faculty, and its current trouble at the start of play.

years.description: Your first year. Two spells, one subject, and a great deal you have not learned yet.
Your second year. One more spell, another potion, and the first taste of a subject that is really yours.
Your third year. A second subject, a first real specialization, and training that sticks.
Your fourth year. The work gets harder, the choices get wider, and the cap on your best trait rises.
Your fifth year. A third subject, a second training, and the first spells that make younger students go quiet.
Your sixth year. The academy expects real work from you, and the libraries start to notice you.
Your final year. Four subjects, a deep library, and the highest cap a student can reach.
